name: company-research-mcp
description: Company Research MCP App: onboarding, purpose-tailored deep research playbooks, and an interactive report UI for Claude.

scripts.build: npm run build:ui && npm run build:server
scripts.build:ui: cross-env INPUT=onboarding.html vite build && cross-env INPUT=report.html vite build && tsx scripts/embed-ui.ts
scripts.harness:build: cross-env INPUT=test/harness/host.html OUT_DIR=dist/harness vite build && cross-env INPUT=test/harness/sandbox.html OUT_DIR=dist/harness vite build
scripts.test: npm run test:protocol && npm run test:ui
